fullPassage: Most people think of the imagination as something internal and private, and it is true that one can imagine something without anyone else knowing about it. But even this purely mental projection has its source in the outside world and the social community that we are a part of. Without drawing on material that exists beyond our selves, no mental image could ever come into being. This means that, while we might believe that our imagination is ours alone, the ingredients that it draws upon are in fact shared by many others. Some might consider this a limitation, but the social quality of imagination actually makes it possible for society to come together around shared values. In fact, the concept of morality depends on this. When we share the same basis for considering possible actions, we are able to make fair judgments about what is right and wrong and formulate social standards that every member of a community can agree upon.

det.korean: morality = 도덕, 도덕성 (옳고 그른 행동에 관한 원칙의 체계)
det.analysis:
❌ ① projection(투영): 정신적 활동으로 행동의 원칙과 무관
❌ ② community(공동체): 사람들의 집단이지 원칙의 체계가 아님
❌ ③ ingredient(재료): 구성 요소이지 행동 원칙이 아님
✅ ④ morality(도덕): 옳고 그른 행동에 관한 원칙의 체계라는 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답
det.tip: morality = 도덕, 도덕성 (moral의 명사형, 사회적 행동 규범)

questions.passage: When we share the same basis for __________ (consider) possible actions, we are able to make fair judgments about what is right and wrong.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

consider → ____

det.korean: 가능한 행동들을 '고려하기 위한' 동일한 기반을 공유할 때.
det.analysis: 전치사 for 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)가 온다. for considering possible actions = 가능한 행동을 고려하기 위해. consider(동사 원형)를 동명사 considering으로 변환.
det.tip: 전치사(for) + 동명사(-ing): for considering = ~을 고려하기 위해

questions.passage: Without drawing on material that __________ (exist) beyond our selves, no mental image could ever come into being.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

exist → ____

det.korean: 우리 자신을 넘어서 '존재하는' 재료를 활용하지 않으면.
det.analysis: 관계대명사 that의 선행사는 material(불가산 명사, 단수 취급). 주어가 3인칭 단수이므로 동사에 -s를 붙여 exists로 변환. that exists beyond our selves = 우리 자신을 넘어서 존재하는.
det.tip: 주어(material) = 불가산 명사 → 3인칭 단수 동사: exists

questions.passage: Most people think of the imagination as something internal and private, and it is true that one can imagine something without anyone else knowing about it. But even this purely mental projection has its source in the outside world and the social community that we are a part of. Without drawing on material that exists beyond our selves, no mental image could ever come into being. This means that, while we might believe that our imagination is ours alone, the ingredients that it draws upon are in fact shared by many others. Some might consider this a limitation, but the social quality of imagination actually makes it possible for society to __________. In fact, the concept of morality depends on this. When we share the same basis for considering possible actions, we are able to make fair judgments about what is right and wrong and formulate social standards that every member of a community can agree upon.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 공유된 가치 주변으로 함께 모이다(come together around shared values). 상상력의 사회적 특성이 사회가 '공유된 가치 주변으로 함께 모이는 것'을 가능하게 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① come together around shared values(공유된 가치 주변으로 함께 모이다): 'makes it possible for society to ______'에서 상상력의 사회적 특성이 가능하게 하는 것 ←정답
❌ ② the outside world(바깥세계): 상상력의 근원이지 사회가 모이는 목적이 아님
❌ ③ something internal and private(내적이고 사적인 것): 도입부 내용으로 빈칸 위치의 '사회를 가능하게 하는 것'과 불일치
❌ ④ make fair judgments(공정한 판단을 내리다): 마지막 문장의 내용이나, 빈칸의 주어가 society이므로 문맥 연결이 부자연스러움
det.tip: come together = 함께 모이다, 하나가 되다

questions.passage: Most people think of the imagination as something internal and private, and it is true that one can imagine something without anyone else knowing about it. But even this purely mental projection has its source in the outside world and the social community that we are a part of. Without drawing on material that exists beyond our selves, no mental image could ever come into being. This means that, while we might believe that our imagination is ours alone, the ingredients that it draws upon are in fact shared by many others. Some might consider this a limitation, but __________ actually makes it possible for society to come together around shared values. In fact, the concept of morality depends on this. When we share the same basis for considering possible actions, we are able to make fair judgments about what is right and wrong and formulate social standards that every member of a community can agree upon.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 상상력의 사회적 특성(the social quality of imagination). 어떤 사람들은 이를 한계로 여길 수 있지만, '상상력의 사회적 특성'이 실제로 사회가 함께 모이는 것을 가능하게 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① our imagination is ours alone(상상력이 우리만의 것): 이전 문장에서 부정된 믿음이므로 but 뒤 긍정적 맥락과 불일치
❌ ② the concept of morality(도덕의 개념): 다음 문장에서 별도로 언급되는 개념
✅ ③ the social quality of imagination(상상력의 사회적 특성): 'Some might consider this a limitation, but ______ actually makes it possible for society to come together'에서 but 뒤 반전 내용으로 가장 적절 ←정답
❌ ④ a purely mental projection(순수하게 정신적인 투영): 도입부 내용으로 빈칸의 '사회를 가능하게 하는' 주체와 불일치
det.tip: the social quality of imagination = 상상력의 사회적 특성 (이 글의 핵심 논지)
